title: Genesis v18.5 Living Threads — Creative Reversal Decision
fundamental_barrier: The free-text interface currently collapses many expressions into a small set of immediate deterministic categories, so meaningful playthroughs converge on the same authored demonstration route.

first_principles.useful_result: A coherent, safe and persistent life whose events remain causally connected to state without forcing the player into a visible moral menu.
measurable: replay equality under the same seed and action sequence
stream divergence under a different seed
resident progress during unrelated player actions
events surfaced with an empty visible choice list
no change to moral state, realm routing or Chronicle validity
first_principles.failure_boundary: Surprise loses usefulness when it becomes cosmetic text, random punishment, fabricated consent, an untraceable oracle, or a hidden change to moral routing.

hypotheses.mechanism: Add more response variants to each existing action category.
hypotheses.prediction: Wording diversity rises but identical semantic routes remain convergent.
hypotheses.destroying_evidence: Players still receive the same sequence of mechanics after paraphrased inputs.
hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Confusing lexical variety with a living world.

hypotheses.mechanism: Add a persistent world-side causal scheduler whose resident threads advance independently of the player.
hypotheses.prediction: Unrelated actions can reveal different resident stages and delayed events without changing core moral state.
hypotheses.destroying_evidence: Resident state changes only after direct player commands or produces no observable later difference.
hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Calling scripted state machines autonomous people.

hypotheses.mechanism: Choose events by maximizing numerical novelty against recent action fingerprints.
hypotheses.prediction: Repeated play produces lower textual repetition.
hypotheses.destroying_evidence: Novelty score changes while perceived causal coherence does not improve.

hypotheses.mechanism: Schedule consequences for later turns and let them mature while other actions occur.
hypotheses.prediction: Earlier actions return after intervening events without appearing as immediate points or rewards.
hypotheses.destroying_evidence: Returned events cannot be traced to a stored source action or always appear immediately.
hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Retrofitting any later scene as a consequence.

hypotheses.mechanism: Use ecological succession and leitmotif logic: residents continue off-screen while symbols recur in changed contexts.
hypotheses.prediction: A symbol can reappear after several turns and gain context without being declared prophecy.
hypotheses.destroying_evidence: Symbols never return, return without persisted state, or are presented as compulsory supernatural truth.
hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Mistaking unexplained symbolism for evidence about reality.

selected_hypothesis.name: Persisted Causal Thread Engine
selected_hypothesis.IF: a world stores a secret per-world seed, independent resident state, delayed causal events and symbol memory
selected_hypothesis.UNDER: frozen God Mode, moral routing, protected-child rules and SHA-256 Chronicle semantics
selected_hypothesis.THEN: the same action language can produce replayable yet initially unpredictable life events that surface outside the visible menu
selected_hypothesis.BECAUSE: event selection depends on persistent world state and elapsed causal turns rather than only the current command category
selected_hypothesis.UNLESS: the resulting variation is merely cosmetic, creates random victims, fabricates consent, changes moral outcomes or cannot be replayed from the same seed

minimal_experiment.control: Genesis v18.4.1 with the same scripted action sequence and no Living Threads layer.
minimal_experiment.intervention: Genesis v18.5 with a frozen test seed and the same action sequence.
minimal_experiment.primary_metric: Presence of persistent unscripted events, independent resident progress, delayed symbol return and deterministic replay without moral-state mutation.
negative_controls: same seed plus same actions must replay identically
different seed should change at least one surfaced event
child role must create no victim and no MoralEcho
silence must not be converted into compulsory moral judgment
stop_conditions: realm or moral state changes because of a Living Thread event
a child receives an unsafe adult event
a simulated resident is represented as a verified conscious person
minimal_experiment.PASS: All automated invariants pass and two equal seeds replay the same stream while a different seed changes the stream.
minimal_experiment.FAIL: Any frozen invariant changes or the stream is neither replayable nor meaningfully state-dependent.
minimal_experiment.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Tests pass technically but human play does not distinguish causal surprise from cosmetic prose.

novelty_boundary: No novelty or prior-art claim is made before a separate review.
